macros.name: clockToggle
macros.doc: The command creates a push button field that is used to toggle the clock on and off (start and pause).

macros.name: cntdwnDisplay
macros.doc: \cntdwnDisplay show the countdown of the timer; \cntdwnStartT is the start button, \cntdwnPauseT is the pause button, and \cntdwnStopT is the stop button.

macros.name: cntdwnEndTarget
macros.doc: When the timer reaches it main time event (time 0 for a countdown clock, and time length for a count-up clock), the default endEvent writes message to the multiline text field created by \cntdwnEndTarget.

macros.name: cntdwnPauseT
macros.doc: \cntdwnDisplay show the countdown of the timer; \cntdwnStartT is the start button, \cntdwnPauseT is the pause button, and \cntdwnStopT is the stop button.

macros.name: cntdwnStartT
macros.doc: \cntdwnDisplay show the countdown of the timer; \cntdwnStartT is the start button, \cntdwnPauseT is the pause button, and \cntdwnStopT is the stop button.

macros.name: lcntdwnDisplay
macros.doc: The command creates a text field that holds the current countdown.

macros.name: lcntdwnToggle
macros.doc: The command creates a push button field that is used to toggle the count on and off (start and pause).
